name.fr-FR: Sermons de saint François de Sales, tome IX
name.en-US: Sermons of St. Francis de Sales, vol. IX
name.pt-BR: Sermões de São Francisco de Sales, tomo IX

description.fr-FR: Les sermons du tome IX de l’édition d’Annecy (vol. III des Sermons, 1593-1622), un sermon par chapitre, en orthographe d’époque.
description.en-US: The sermons in volume IX of the Annecy edition (Sermons, vol. III; 1593-1622), one sermon per chapter, in period spelling.
description.pt-BR: Os sermões do tomo IX da edição de Annecy (1593-1622).

sources.edition: Œuvres de saint François de Sales, édition complète d’après les autographes et les éditions originales, t. IX: Sermons, 1896-1898 (file 09), Annecy: J. Niérat, 1892-1932. Scans with text layer (2022 re-OCR) from donboscosanto.eu.
sources.description: Francis’s text in the original 17th-century spelling, extracted from the PDF text layer (layout mode). Marginal references, variants and footnotes, the editors’ introductions and tables are not included. Sermon titles come from the headings and dates printed above each sermon.
sources.tierEvidence: Francis died in 1622; the Annecy edition is of his own text in period spelling, published in or before 1932. Only Francis’s own text is used, not the editors’ apparatus.
